signature: INTEGER FUNCTION DLANEG( N, D, LLD, SIGMA, PIVMIN, R )

params.name: d
params.reference: The N diagonal elements of the diagonal matrix D.

params.name: sigma
params.reference: Shift amount in T - $\sigma$ $I = L$ D L^T.

params.name: pivmin
params.reference: The minimum pivot in the Sturm sequence. May be used when zero pivots are encountered on non-IEEE-754 architectures.

params.name: r
params.reference: The twist index for the twisted factorization that is used for the negcount.
